lines.name: Illumina
lines.description: Wella Illumina — acidic demi-permanent hair color with zero lift. Luminescence technology for light reflection through the cuticle. Up to 100% grey coverage. Ammonia-free, pH 6.5.

categories.pure-naturals: Natural base shades for coverage and depth
categories.rich-naturals: Fashion naturals with reflect — ash, gold, violet, pearl, cendre
categories.warm-naturals: Warm natural shades with gold and brown reflect
categories.cool-naturals: Cool natural shades with ash, cendre, pearl reflect
categories.deep-browns: Warm and cool brown reflects (/7 series)
categories.special-mix: Concentrated intensifiers — Matte, Cendre, Red, Violet, Copper, Pearl Ash

applicationNotes: Apply to clean, dry or slightly damp hair
For toning on pre-lightened hair: use 1.9% (6vol), process 5–20 min visual
For grey coverage: use 4% (13vol), process 20 min without heat
Rinse thoroughly; shampoo and condition as normal

toneSystem.description: Wella International Tone Numbering: Level/Tone format (e.g., 7/43 = level 7 copper-gold)

specialNotes: Illumina is Wella's premium acidic demi-permanent with Luminescence technology
Zero lift — ideal for toning, refreshing, and grey coverage on natural base
Use Welloxon Perfect developer only (1.9% or 4%)
Special Mix intensifiers (0/XX) can be used to boost reflect or customize tones
